title: Bind actual compact TARGET114 to the physical caller boundary
body:
The changed compact caller now has a source-bound physical CALL/RETURN refinement package. Its complete owner admission census covers 178,528 same-family occurrences and 2,595 distinct chart pairs with exact nonzero coordinate witnesses for every source-admissible odd prime. All 84 logical-source files match the retained physical caller byte for byte.

The package fixes the composition boundary by binding the existing scratch allocator's archive-location selector only after both authenticators and all source equalities pass. An unbound negative control reproduces the original allocation rejection. Calibration uses the unchanged compiler's actual TARGET114 residual emitter: request 1933, rank 7, width 640 → 70, child PC 2 → backward successor PC 3. It restores all 29,096 permanent roles and physical numerical banks and checks owned backing erasure, borrowed input preservation, and malformed CALL rejection.

An independent AI review reconstructed the owner witnesses directly from raw artifacts and found no blocker. The source notices and predecessor attribution remain intact.

No complete GL64 payload/NODE execution, primitive formal closure, H2 tariff, arbitrary-stock outer wrapper, P3 admission, new kappa, or selected-frontier change is claimed. Open next questions remain in the package.
